Smt. Cheethirala Shyamaladevi vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh
on 16 November, 2023
 In The High Court Of Andhra Pradesh: Amaravati

entities.text: High Court Of Andhra Pradesh: Amaravati
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Honourable Sri Justice Subba Reddy Satti
 Writ Petition No.29749 of 2023
 Cheethirala Shyamaladevi, W/o Nagarjuna
 Rao Cheethirala, aged : 52 years, Occ:
 Housewife, R/o Door No.8/585-A, Giddangi
 Street, Proddatur Town, Ysr Kadapa District,
 Andhra Pradesh.

...  Petitioner  Versus  The State of Andhra Pradesh, Rep. by its  Principal Secretary, Municipal Administration  and Urban Development Department,
 Secretariat Buildings, Velagapudi, Amaravathi,
 Guntur District, A.P. and four others.
 ...

Respondents Counsel for the petitioner : Sri V. Nitesh Counsel for respondents : GP for Municipal  Administration and  Urban Development and  Sri N. Ranga Reddy,
 learned standing counsel  and GP for Roads and  Buildings  :: ORDER :
:
The grievance of the petitioner is that respondent Nos.2 to 5 gave marking to the petitioner's property bearing door SRSJ No.13/600, Mydukur Road, Revenue Ward No.13, Proddatur Town, YSR Kadapa District, Andhra Pradesh, without issuing any notice and are taking steps to demolish the structure to an extent of 10 feet.

2. Heard learned counsel on either side.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that without following the procedure mandated under Section 174 of the Andhra Pradesh Municipalities Act 1965 (for short the 'Act') or The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013,

sentences.text: the authorities came to the subject property on 06.11.2023 and gave markings.
He submits that on 10.11.2023, the officials demolished portion of steps and left the place directing the petitioner to demolish portion up to the marking.
4. Learned standing counsel, on instructions of Commissioner of respondent No.2 submits that road widening process is being undertaken and the authorities gave markings.
He would further submit that authorities are SRSJ not demolishing the structures.
The authorities will issue notice and follow due process in accordance with the Act.

5. In view of the instructions of the Commissioner of respondent No.2, this writ petition is disposed of at the stage of admission, directing the authorities to follow the procedure contemplated under the Act, i.e. issuing notice, considering explanation, if necessary, by providing opportunity of hearing etc., before demolishing the structure bearing door No.13/600, Mydukur Road, Revenue Ward No.13, Proddatur Town, YSR Kadapa District, Andhra Pradesh.
As a sequel, pending miscellaneous petitions, if any, shall stand closed.
